name: Sudou Himeka
source:
A beautiful woman who came to Hanazono High School as a substitute Japanese history teacher to cover a maternity leave.

In reality, she is a private detective who was requested to investigate and solve the murder case of Makie, the granddaughter of the school's board chairman. She promises a reward to the protagonist and requests his cooperation in the investigation.
